sources.title: K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B is the sparse member of the K2-Horizon family: a Mixture-of-Experts model with Mixture-of-Values attention (MoVA) that stores 36B parameters and runs 4B per token. We have released the final checkpoint; intermediate checkpoints, along with the data and the training code, will be released.

sources.title: K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview K2-Horizon-MoVA-36B-A4B-GGUF is a text-generation model from IFM, distributed as GGUF files for llama.cpp. It is the sparse member of the K2-Horizon family: a Mixture-of-Experts model with Mixture-of-Values attention (MoVA), 36 billion stored parameters, and 4 billion active parameters per token.
